fields.headline: Accepts up to $30,000 from Alameda County Office of Education to launch an arts learning design team
fields.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) between the district and the Alameda County Office of Education (ACOE) launches an Arts Learning District Design Team to increase arts learning in the district. ACOE pays the district up to $30,000, invoiced at least twice during the term, which runs January 27 to June 30, 2021. The funding comes from an ACOE design team funding program.

21-0040.note: Corrected: the attached MOU shows the Alameda County Office of Education pays the District up to $30,000, not the District paying the County Office.
21-0040.sourceIssue: The text gives an amount not to exceed $30,000.00 but does not say whether the District pays it to, or receives it from, the Alameda County Office of Education.
